synthesis_checks: Every relied-on capture was rehashed against its content hash and metadata (205 east, 98 west).
The decisive statement of every addition and status update was re-read in the capture or PDF text.
Every new-site point was recomputed independently from the raw captures with pyproj and shapely.
Every addition was screened against the thirty-first and thirty-third datasets, the thirty-first holds and the other wave.
Both syntheses built and validated the change set with the real builder on the thirty-first and thirty-third bases.

collection_notes: Raw captures stay in git-ignored local_data directories and are not redistributed.

Third-party personal data in public registers was not copied into sources, summaries or holds.
